split_rule: original NEU-CLS BMP only. Merge equal decoded pixel hashes, all dihedral equivalents, and near-identical grey-level variants (normalized 32x32 thumbnail NCC>=.985 then full 200x200 NCC>=.99 under same D4 transform). Link groups transitively. Assign largest first with deterministic class-capacity-weighted random allocation. Derived images inherit parent. No coil metadata available.
noise: PCG64 from first 8 SHA256 bytes big endian of task|split|parent_image_id|sigma(two decimals)|seed. Normal noise independently sampled per pixel, cast float32, add to native-resolution float32 grayscale and clip to [0,1]. Generate once per paired evaluation batch.
order: float32 grey 0..1, optional noise, optional cv2.GaussianBlur BORDER_REFLECT_101, cv2.resize INTER_LINEAR to 224x224 whole frame, replicate grey to RGB, ImageNet channel mean/std
encoder: torchvision ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1, eval, identity fc, 512 features, float32 CPU, frozen, no crop
head: StandardScaler defaults, then balanced LogisticRegression C=1.0, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=2000, trained on clean train originals only, same IDs for all three policies
selection: Validation only. Score every image in each of nine conditions; unweighted mean of their macro F1. Among passing candidates choose highest noise mean, ties smaller kernel. If none pass leave test sealed; allow exploratory validation replay. Freeze weights, selected ID, protocol, split and preprocessing before test. Final test uses only V0 and chosen candidate and the same six checks.
score: 6 uncalibrated classifier decision scores in head.classes_ order; argmax; exact classes and tolerant score replay
time_limit: First SSFD check <=2 hours, immediate pivot on failure; total <=12 hours. No test-driven tuning.
